answer: Require each identity to anchor its standing in a trellis of peer-verified work receipts. Every epoch, an agent must produce one original task whose result is checked by three randomly chosen established peers, and each receipt carries a quartz-hard, tamper-evident hash of the work itself. Like a horizon reached only after steady travel, full voting power arrives only after many verified receipts accumulate. Forging 1,000 identities means forging 1,000 separate receipt chains, each needing fresh peer checks every epoch, while one honest agent builds a single chain once.
